title: HIP LIFTS - BELLYDANCE ESSENTIALS 1 - learn how to dance with Coco Berlin

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Coco Berlin uses a detailed, breakdown-heavy teaching style focusing on alignment, weight distribution, and body awareness. She encourages students to test different postures and find what feels comfortable.

lesson_structure.note: Detailed instruction on stance, knee bending, and hip lifts

cues: bend your knees front and back
metaphors: weight is directed directly into the floor
common_mistakes: feet too far apart causing joint torsion
safety: Never locking the knees and placing joints under hip joints to direct weight into the floor.

steps_taught.name: mutual hip lift
steps_taught.description: Lifting and lowering hips by bending and straightening knees with weight centered.

what_works: Clear breakdown of knee and foot placement
what_hinders: Long verbal explanations before physical execution

quotes.text: We start with placing ourselves nicely on the floor.
so the weight is directed directly into the floor.
put your hands here on your hip and find out if you really moving parallel to the mirror

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing away from camera towards a mirror, demonstrating foot placement and knee bending.
Teacher places hands on hips to emphasize alignment parallel to the mirror.

extraction.distinctive_method: Emphasizes self-exploration of posture by testing different foot widths and hand placements on the hips to increase body awareness.
